videos.author: Braydon Morgan
videos.text:
Loaded Sweet Potato

A fluffy baked sweet potato loaded with creamy burrata, juicy roasted garlic tomatoes, fresh avocado, a poached egg & a drizzle of chili oil. Simple ingredients, BIG flavor!!

Ingredients
1 large sweet potato
1 ball burrata
1 cup cherry tomatoes
3–4 garlic cloves
1/2 avocado, sliced
1 poached egg
Olive oil
Salt & pepper
Chili oil, to taste

Instructions
Preheat oven to 400°F. Pierce the sweet potato with a fork and bake for 45–60 minutes, or until fork-tender.
Add cherry tomatoes and garlic cloves to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt & pepper, and roast for 20–25 minutes until softened, blistered, and juicy.
Slice open the sweet potato and fluff the inside with a fork. Season with a little salt if needed.
Top with creamy burrata, roasted garlic tomatoes, sliced avocado, and a freshly poached egg.
Finish with a generous drizzle of chili oil and enjoy!!

#sweetpotato #bakedpotato #loadedpotato #easyrecipe #simplerecipe

videos.author: Braydon Morgan
videos.text:
One Pan Peanut Chili Oil Noodles

Comment “YES” and I’ll send you the full recipe card WITH INSTRUCTIONS!!

Thick, chewy noodles tossed in a rich, spicy peanut chili oil sauce with garlic, sesame seeds & fresh green onions…

For the Noodles:
1 serving thick, hand-cut noodles (or any noodles you like)

For the Peanut Chili Oil Sauce:
1 tbsp peanut butter 2 tbsp chili flakes (optional) 4 green onions, sliced 4 tbsp sesame seeds 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chili oil crisp 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce 1/4 cup neutral oil (I use avocado oil) Reserved pasta water, as needed

For Garnish:
Sliced green onions Extra sesame seeds (optional)

Instructions:
Cook noodles according to package instructions. Before draining, reserve some pasta water
Add sliced green onions, minced garlic, sesame seeds, chili flakes & chili oil crisp to a heat-safe bowl
Heat neutral oil in a small saucepan until hot, then carefully pour over the aromatics to release their flavor
Stir in peanut butter, rice vinegar & dark soy sauce until everything is well combined
Add the cooked noodles to the sauce and toss until evenly coated, adding a splash of reserved pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce
Garnish with sliced green onions and extra sesame seeds. Serve immediately!

How to cut an avocado PERFECTLY 🥑

1. Slice the avocado in half and cut off the top
2. Peel back the outer skin
3. Slice from bottom to top without moving the avocado
4. Use your knife to gently fan out and flatten each slice
5. Be super cool 😎
